import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

main = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
group, name, *args = sys.argv[1:]
root = Path('/tmp/p49-terminal-' + group)
out = main / 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/phase2/execution' / group
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
venv = Path('/tmp/p49-a0-regression-43a6aa6')
env = dict(os.environ)
for key in ('PYTHONPATH', 'MYPYPATH', 'PYTEST_ADDOPTS', 'PYTEST_PLUGINS'):
    env.pop(key, None)
env.update(VIRTUAL_ENV=str(venv), PATH=str(venv/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin',
    PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD='1', PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',
    PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join(map(str, sorted(root.glob('*/scripts')))))
argv = [a.replace('{root}',str(root)).replace('{venv}',str(venv)) for a in args]
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=root, text=True).strip()
assert not (out/(name+'.log')).exists(), name
head, tree = git('rev-parse','HEAD'), git('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}')
tracked_diff = git('diff','HEAD','--stat')
assert not tracked_diff, tracked_diff
result = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=root, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
record = dict(argv=argv,cwd=str(root),head=head,tree=tree,exit_code=result.returncode,
    environment={k:env.get(k) for k in ('VIRTUAL_ENV','PATH','PYTHONPATH','MYPYPATH','PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD','PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE')},
    recorder_source=Path(__file__).read_text(), output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(result.stdout).hexdigest())
for arg in argv:
    p = Path(arg)
    if arg.startswith('/tmp/') and p.suffix=='.py' and p.is_file():
        record.setdefault('diagnostic_programs',{})[arg]=p.read_text()
(out/(name+'.log')).write_bytes(result.stdout)
(out/(name+'.command.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
sys.stdout.buffer.write(result.stdout)
print(f'GROUP={group} HEAD={head} EXIT={result.returncode}',flush=True)
sys.exit(result.returncode)

import collections
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import shlex

root = Path('/home/linhao/Toolchain/development/LogAnalysisSkill')
phase2 = root / 'docs/clang-fix-campaign/dev_memory/stage14_p49_terminal_batch/a0-evidence/phase2'
out = phase2 / 'execution/REG03b'
baseline = json.loads((phase2 / 'gate-package/regression-set-proof.full.json').read_text())
current = {}
for line in (out / 'pytest-ci.log').read_text().splitlines():
    match = re.match(r'.*?(tests/.+) (PASSED|SKIPPED|FAILED|ERROR)(?:\s+\[|$)', line)
    if match:
        assert match[1] not in current, match[1]
        current[match[1]] = match[2]
old = baseline['current_results']
proof = {
    'baseline': '74ff34c gate-package/regression-set-proof.full.json:current_results',
    'tested_head': '787b8040245907c3c849d80478e30961d26a4ed2',
    'baseline_count': len(old),
    'current_count': len(current),
    'counts': dict(collections.Counter(current.values())),
    'removed': sorted(old.keys() - current.keys()),
    'added': sorted(current.keys() - old.keys()),
    'changed': [key for key in old.keys() & current.keys() if old[key] != current[key]],
    'approved_deletions_still_passed': {
        key: current.get(key) for key in baseline['proposed_deletions_still_present_and_passed']
    },
    'current_results': current,
    'generator_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
assert len(current) == 1344, len(current)
assert proof['counts'] == {'PASSED': 1343, 'SKIPPED': 1}, proof['counts']
assert not proof['removed'] and not proof['added'] and not proof['changed']
assert set(proof['approved_deletions_still_passed'].values()) == {'PASSED'}
(out / 'nodeid-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
print('NODEIDS baseline=1344 current=1344 removed=0 added=0 verdict_changes=0')
print('APPROVED_DELETIONS still_present_and_passed=4 deleted=0')

checkers = json.loads((out / 'checkers/commands.json').read_text())
rows = ['# PHASE2-03 全套门禁实测', '',
        '取证 HEAD: `787b8040245907c3c849d80478e30961d26a4ed2`; 独立工作树 `/tmp/p49-terminal-REG03b`。',
        '下表由 `checkers/commands.json` 机械生成;负控制的预期 exit=1,不等于执行失败可充作证伪。',
        '完整 argv、环境、日志 hash 与执行器源码见该 JSON;原始输出逐项链接。', '',
        '| 命令 | 预期 exit | 实际 exit | 对账 | 原文 |',
        '|---|---|---|---|---|']
for item in checkers['results']:
    command = shlex.join(['python', *[arg.replace('docs/clang-fix-campaign/tools/', '') for arg in item['argv'][1:]]])
    rows.append(f"| `{command}` | {item['expected_exit']} | {item['exit_code']} | {'PASS' if item['matched'] else 'FAIL'} | [{item['name']}](checkers/{item['name']}.log) |")
rows += ['', f"合计: {len(checkers['results'])} 条;符合预期 {sum(r['matched'] for r in checkers['results'])};不符合预期 {len(checkers['failed'])}。", '',
         '## 全仓与 CI', '', '| 命令 | exit | 结果 |', '|---|---|---|']
for name in ('pytest-ci', 'mypy-ci', 'ruff', 'lint-imports'):
    metadata = json.loads((out / (name + '.command.json')).read_text())
    command = shlex.join(['python' if arg.endswith('/bin/python') else arg for arg in metadata['argv']])
    rows.append(f"| `{command}` | {metadata['exit_code']} | [原文]({name}.log); [命令与环境]({name}.command.json) |")
rows += ['', '本地 pytest: **1343 passed / 1 skipped**,coverage **94.62%**。',
         '完整 nodeid 集合与批准包逐项对比:1344 个全保留,状态变化0;4个拟删测试尚未删除。见 [nodeid-proof.json](nodeid-proof.json)。', '',
         '远端 GitHub Actions [37612769455](https://github.com/lhmax2010/LogAnalysisSkill/actions/runs/37612769455) 执行原样 ci.yml:',
         'checkout/setup-python/系统依赖/Python依赖/Lint/Type check 均 success;Tests exit **1**, **106 failed / 1237 passed / 1 skipped**。',
         '原文明确 checkout 使用 `--depth=1`,历史blob读取失败(`AUTHORITY_GIT_BLOB`);无权以本地绿代替远端失败。',
         '状态 API 未提供成功步骤的数字 exit,此处仅如实记 success;远端 Tests 的数字 exit1来自原始日志。',
         '`gh run view --log` 自身 exit0仅表示取日志成功,不表示CI通过。',
         '见 [CI步骤状态](ci-status.log)、[完整CI日志](ci-log.log)、[读取命令](ci-log.command.json)。', '',

         'REG03/ 是首次补登记后的诊断日志,含命令选择纠正前的输出;本表仅采用 REG03b 的复跑结果。',
         'E11-5 已停用的静态发现管线没有重新充作现行设计门禁;其原有单测仍包含在全仓pytest中。']
(out / 'gate-results.md').write_text('\n'.join(rows) + '\n')
print(f"CHECKERS commands={len(checkers['results'])} unexpected={len(checkers['failed'])}")
